test_command: mkdir -p /workspace/test-results && rm -f /workspace/test-results/output.json && cd /workspace/repo && sed -i 's/ --target exiv2lib//' CMakeLists.txt && mkdir -p build && cd build && cmake -DBUILD_TESTING=ON .. && make -j$(nproc) && cd test && ./test --gtest_filter=-dsmServiceAltitude.Normal --gtest_output=json:/tmp/raw_gtest.json && python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('/tmp/raw_gtest.json')); ts=d.pop('testsuites',[]); out={'testsuites':ts}; out.update(d); json.dump(out,open('/workspace/test-results/output.json','w'))"
